landing.title: Build your Closing Celebration slideshow
landing.subtitle: Upload the results export from the DI Scoring Program, add your assets, choose a few options, and CelebrationDeck assembles the slideshow that reveals your results.

who.title: Who can use this
who.body: CelebrationDeck is offered to Destination Imagination regions and affiliates. Access is by approval: sign in, request access, and an administrator will approve your account.

one.title: Upload results
one.body: Provide the results export (CSV) from the DI Scoring Program, and optionally a special-awards export.

two.title: Add assets & options
two.body: Add your tournament's images and pick your options. Defaults come from the season set by an administrator.

three.title: Generate the deck
three.body: CelebrationDeck builds a slideshow that reveals placements and advancing teams, ready to present.

footer.disclaimer: CelebrationDeck is an independent tool and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Destination Imagination, Inc. No DI logos or trademarks are used; "Destination Imagination" is referenced only to describe the tool's purpose.

auth.signInBody: Choose how you'd like to sign in.
auth.orgAccountNote: You can use a work or school account, but some organizations block sign-in to outside apps. If yours asks for administrator approval and you can't get it, sign in with a personal Google or Microsoft account instead.

requestAccess.title: Request access
requestAccess.body: Your account isn't approved yet. Tell us a little about you and an administrator will review your request.
requestAccess.error: Something went wrong submitting your request. Please try again.

pending.title: Request received
pending.body: Thanks! Your access request is pending review. Approval takes effect the next time you sign in. You can close this page.

denied.title: Access not granted
denied.body: Your access request was not approved. If you think this is a mistake, please contact the administrator.

otherLanguages.title: Help translate CelebrationDeck
otherLanguages.intro: CelebrationDeck is built to support many languages. Only the interface text needs translating — the data you enter stays in whatever language you type.
otherLanguages.how: Translations live as simple text files in the open-source repository. To add or improve a language, open the repository and submit your translation as a pull request, or contact the maintainer.
otherLanguages.placeholderNote: This is a placeholder page. Detailed contributor instructions will be added here.
